symptom: selected-field chat returns operationStatus=error (model_failed) for documents whose retrieval and resolver succeed; telemetry: resolve_evidence succeeded count=1, write_answer started, then generate_answer/write_answer error model_failed (~3 s)
reproduction: operator-side single Converse call with the deployed writer request builder on the synthetic notice (1 Bedrock call): provider returns {answer, relationships:[{actor:'recipient',action:'respond within thirty (30) days of delivery',recipient:'sender'}]}; validate_answer_writer_result passes; evidence_requires_relationship_projection is False; validate_writer_relationships_against_evidence raises EvidenceContractError 'writer relationship is not supported in evidence order'
rootCause: backend/src/legaldesk/chat.py:663-665 validates every optional writer relationship against the evidence token order (backend/src/legaldesk/evidence.py:372-411) even when the evidence does not require a relationship projection; a paraphrased relation ('sender' is not in the passage) aborts the whole answer as model_failed instead of being dropped. The failure is swallowed into the generic model_failed code, so logs do not show the cause.
suggestedFix: when evidence_requires_relationship_projection is False, discard writer relationships (keep the prose answer, which is still grounding-validated) or treat an unsupported optional relation as absent; log a closed error class (relationship_unsupported). Add a regression test with a writer stub returning a paraphrased optional relationship.
